mapper.select: SELECT p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.stlm_mthd_cd FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id}
SELECT p.cntrct_ty_cd,p.stlm_mthd_cd FROM prj.prj p WHERE p.prj_id=#{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT c.cls_stts_cd FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=#{month}

SELECT a.asgn_id,a.dev_id,m.mm_qty AS assignment_mm, price.bill_untprc_amt IS NOT NULL AS price_available, count(*) OVER(PARTITION BY a.dev_id) AS assignment_count, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bill.bill_dtl d JOIN bill.bill b ON b.bill_id=d.bill_id JOIN asgn.asgn ba ON ba.asgn_id=d.asgn_id WHERE b.bill_stts_cd='CONFIRM' AND b.prj_id=#{projectId} AND ba.dev_id=a.dev_id AND d.work_ym=#{month}) AS billed, t.work_day_qty,t.rglr_tm_qty,t.ovtm_tm_qty,t.mth_work_day_qty FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND m.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN bill.dspch_atnd t ON t.prj_id=a.prj_id AND t.dev_id=a.dev_id AND t.work_ym=#{month} LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT h.bill_untprc_amt FROM asgn.untprc_hist h WHERE h.asgn_id=a.asgn_id AND h.aply_bgn_dt <= GREATEST(#{firstDay},a.bgn_dt) ORDER BY h.aply_bgn_dt DESC LIMIT 1 ) price ON true WHERE a.prj_id=#{projectId} AND p.cntrct_ty_cd='DP' AND p.stlm_mthd_cd IN ('DAY','HOUR') AND a.untprc_base_cd=p.stlm_mthd_cd AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{lastDay} AND a.end_dt >= #{firstDay} ORDER BY a.dev_id,a.asgn_id
SELECT FROM bill.dspch_atnd t WHERE t.prj_id=#{projectId} AND t.work_ym=#{month} ORDER BY t.dev_id,t.atnd_id
SELECT FROM bill.dspch_atnd t WHERE t.prj_id=#{projectId} AND t.work_ym=#{month} ORDER BY t.dev_id,t.atnd_id FOR UPDATE

INSERT INTO bill.dspch_atnd(work_ym,prj_id,dev_id,asgn_id,work_day_qty,rglr_tm_qty, ovtm_tm_qty,mth_work_day_qty,created_by) VALUES(#{scope.month},#{scope.projectId},#{input.dev_id},#{input.asgn_id},#{input.work_day_qty}, #{input.rglr_tm_qty},#{input.ovtm_tm_qty},#{input.mth_work_day_qty},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(work_ym,prj_id,dev_id) DO UPDATE SET asgn_id=EXCLUDED.asgn_id, work_day_qty=EXCLUDED.work_day_qty,rglr_tm_qty=EXCLUDED.rglr_tm_qty, ovtm_tm_qty=EXCLUDED.ovtm_tm_qty,mth_work_day_qty=EXCLUDED.mth_work_day_qty, upld_id=NULL,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,updated_by=#{actor} RETURNING atnd_id
